statement.zh: 垣曲商城为晋南早商城址，有 1996 勘察报告与 2014 第二卷发掘报告。
statement.en: Yuanqu Shang City is an early Shang walled center in southern Shanxi with 1996 survey and 2014 Vol. 2 excavation reports.
